newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Absa busy as investors head for banks.
newsitem.headline: Absa busy as investors head for banks.

text.p: Shares in Amalgamated Banks of South Africa Ltd (Absa) attracted heavy market attention on Thursday as investors snapped up the stock on the back of rival bank Investec Ltd recent strong results, dealers said.
"Absa is seen as one of the cheaper stocks in the sector and after Investec's results people are becoming interested in the share," one dealer said.
Absa shares edged up 10 cents to 29.95 rand, near its year high of 30.75 rand, in a series of bookover deals -- where a single broker arranges a deal.
Nearly 1.2 million shares changed hands in trade valued at 35.5 million shares.

Investec on Wednesday reported headline diluted earnings per share up 36.3 percent at 572.1 cents, well ahead of a Reuters poll of analysts who expected a rise to between 550.0 and 558.3 cents a share.
Investec shares were up 250 cents to 152.50 rand by 0915 GMT.
Absa is set to post its year results on Monday, May 26.
